name: promptus
description: A file-based research knowledge system: gated Markdown truth, bounded lexical retrieval, provenance and artifact checks, debt-ratcheted health, and a plain-language human read port.

interface.shortDescription: Gated research memory for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Store, retrieve, verify, and explain research knowledge with stable IDs, epistemic status, bounded lexical search, reproducible artifacts, and a canonical Markdown link graph.
defaultPrompt: Use Promptus to record and retrieve this project's research decisions.
Check the Promptus store before making claims about prior work.
